summary: Internal streamed shard scan format used while a query assembles complete results.
transport: ReadableStream of UTF-8 bytes between Durable Object actors inside a Worker invocation.
framing: One JSON object per newline; chunks may split UTF-8 code points or records. A scan must end with one explicit matching scan-complete record; clean EOF alone is failure.
version: Internal tuple and scan-complete records; no independent compatibility version.

messages.name: fact tuple
messages.summary: One entity/value result from a shard scan.

messages.name: scan-complete
messages.summary: Explicit terminal count certifying successful exhaustion of the shard query.

fields.name: tuples
fields.note: Must equal the number of preceding tuple records.

parsing.summary: The query coordinator validates each JSON frame, canonical entity URI, tagged value, tuple count, byte count, row size, terminal placement, and fatal UTF-8 decoding before accepting a scan.
